The driver is warned if the pedestrians vulnerability of collision is high low or medium. Tracking exploits the spatiotemporal relation between frames, thereby reducing the computational cost and improving the overall runtime performance of the system. Experimental results on publicly available pedestrian dataset show that our system is capable of robustly detection, tracking and finding the vulnerability of the pedestrians to alert the driver for taking the necessary action before any collision or accident occurs.

articleTitle: Designing of a Remote Sensor System with Data Logging and Temperature Sensing Facility
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: This system deals with the design and development of a remote temperature control system along with the real time data logging facility. The system utilizes thermistor to sense the temperature of the ambiance in a process control application and implements a direct digital control method for controlling the temperature. In addition the recorded temperature values are stored with respect to time this in returns helps us to understand the temperature change in the environment and we can implement or take action accordingly. The decision making device is cub bled with other peripherals like LCD, memory, real time clock and keyboard. The system utilizes the RS232 protocol for communication. The system and application code is designed in Keil 5.0 and .NET frame work using C#. This system utilizes an error free communication and a cost efficient system for industrialize the system is so friendly as it utilizes ISP technology to burn the system code that one can easily manipulate it according to the user needs hence it may be considered as the user friendly device for small scale industry.

articleTitle: An Innovative Position Detection Pathway to Facilitate Low-Cost Home Automation
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: The paper presents an innovative position detection pathway to facilitate low-cost smart home. In the work, an energy efficient, low-cost, smart home automation system has been developed and implemented, using dedicated sensors, electronic circuits, and microcontrollers. The key advantage of this contribution is that it supports also semi-automatic operation using Bluetooth and Internet of Things, which is capable of interacting with an android app-based home automation system for manipulating the operating conditions in a unified manner. In contrast with the earlier work addressed in the literature, the developed prototype appears unique as because, it incorporates the concept of automatic position sensing of the persons and their motion detection inside the room. The position detection scheme enables the lights to glow according to the position of persons entered into the automation environment. Thus, the proposed system contributes to the society by developing a cost optimal and energy efficient smart home automation system, which invalidate the need for costly sensors and implementation issues in the existing frameworks.

articleTitle: Keyword Spotting in Historical Bangla Handwritten Document Image Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a segmentation-free keyword spotting method for historical Bangla Handwritten Document images. For a given query keyword, the proposed method generates a set of candidate text regions within a document image using Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG) features. Next, the set of candidate text regions are fed to a trained Convolution Neural Network (CNN) model. The network finds the class label of each candidate text region and the regions whose class labels are same as the class label of the query word, are spotted in the document image. The proposed method is tested on three historical handwritten Bengali datasets and one historical English handwritten dataset. Detailed performance analysis demonstrates the goodness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Rough Set Approach for Knowledge Acquisition on Vector-Borne Diseases
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Rough Set Theory (RST) is considered to be one of the feasible and effective methodologies in the applications of database mining and found to be an important tool for knowledge discovery from relational datasets. RST and its variances, covering based RST (CRST) in particular offer their suitability to discover relational patterns even from the data sets having incomplete and inconsistent information. The rate of infection and persistent transmission of virus due to vector-borne diseases (VBD) in medical data analysis is high due to high mobility of infected host and uncertainty in the available clinical data sets. The objective of this research is to find the suitability of RST and CRST methodologies in VBD based clinical data sets and to explore knowledge from such data sets. The approach certainly explores the usage of RST in allied applications in medical/clinical datasets.

articleTitle: Analysis of Weather Parameters on Electrical Energy Consumption of a Residential Building
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: This paper aims to collect and encapsulate data regarding the modelling efforts made to predict the energy consumption of residential buildings using a prominent statistical method, to help in prediction the subsequent conservation of energy (electricity) consumed in the residential building sector. Among the various statistical methods available linear regression analysis is considered a good option in case of availability of historic building use data via smart metering techniques as it provides reasonably accurate results with a simple approach. In this study, linear and multiple regression analysis were conducted on data collected from a residential building so as to obtain the best model for prediction purposes. The average temperature parameter emerged as the most important predictor variable and relative humidity as the least having low or negative correlations. Also, the study of the cumulative effect of all the independent parameters on the building use variables proved that it is best to incorporate the effects of all the independent variables to obtain accurate results.

articleTitle: Auto Generation of Gold Standard, Class Labeled Data Set and Ontology Extension Tool [QuadW]
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Automatic Knowledge Extraction (AKE) from domain independent, unstructured text sources is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing and Text analytics. Though, supervised learning mechanisms are very much result promising, application is painful due to the mandatory requirement of a class labeled training data set, as it involves expensive manual effort which is more time consuming. As a solution for this problem, this paper introduces a novel mechanism to build a self-learned classifier model that can automatically generate class labeled training data set for Knowledge/Information Extraction from domain independent unstructured text. Sri Lankan English newspapers (which comprise unstructured text in unconstrained domains) are the main data source for this study and a prototype was built to Professional Information Extraction with the semantic pattern Who holds/held What position, Where and When (Four words start with `W', hence named `QuadW'). Methodology uses advanced machine learning techniques such as, a Random Forest with Adaboost ensemble algorithm to build a composite classification model. This classifier is called as self-learned since, it generates its own training data set automatically. This composite model has improved accuracy and avoided over fitting to data as well. The rule-based feature extraction algorithm and the hand-craft ontology developed, can also be considered as novel components of this study. Self-learned classifier has been extensively improved and tested to show higher accuracy with precision and recall close to one. Therefore, the classified output from the self-learned classifier can be used as a gold-standard data set for future research in Professional Information Extraction. The constructed ontology with approximately 400 facts, also can be effectively used in future researches. Further, introduced classifier can be used as a tool to extend the existing ontology as well. A novel usage of machine learning algorithms to text classification demonstrates that, this study goes with the state-of-the-art technologies.

articleTitle: Selecting Project Team Members through MBTI Method: An Investigation with Homophily and Behavioural Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Myers Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) is the method through which test is done to measure the psychological condition of a person in viewing the world and making the decision. It is generally divided into 4 preference sets namely,' Extraversion - Introversion,' `Sensing - Intuition',' Thinking - Feeling',' Judgment - Perception'. This test is applied in many areas like, for recruitment of people into jobs, to choose career depending on one's personality, to estimate a person himself/herself, selecting optional subjects in universities. Here, the aim of the research work was to propose an optimized prediction analysis for allotting members to a project by the Project Manager by testing the members' ability through MBTI testing method and further analyzing and justifying that the person selected was most suitable for the project or required some advice for their improvement in the work. By using MBTI assessment the dataset for the proposed work has been created. For developing the experimental work, collection of answers for the predesigned questionnaire available in MBTI site from our college students were taken. Based on these data a novel method was developed to select a group of members who are fit to be in that project according to the requirements of the project manager. This is done through Homophily affect and thus study the behavior of each member within the group to test the rate of appropriate members selected by the project manager. Simulation was done by using R-studio and MATLAB thereby identifying the weak and strong bond among the members of the project.

articleTitle: Perturbed Layered Graphs
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Several graph theoretic measures are known to be computationally intractable on general graphs. In some scenarios, if a graph is restricted in a certain manner then the corresponding measure is shown to be tractable. Restricted graphs include bipartite, chordal, tree, grid, planar and interval. Computation of the maximum independent set i.e. MIS, the minimum vertex cover i.e. MVC, and the minimum dominating set i.e. MDS is shown to be NP-hard. However, these measures are shown to have myriad applications on tractable classes. A layered graph consists of several subgraphs, each containing at most some k vertices. Each subgraph is a layer and the inter-layer edges are restricted to the vertices in adjacent layers. A graph class that has layered graphs as a sub-class has been proposed where O(1) inter-layer edges originating from each layer need not terminate in an adjacent layer. We call the graph class where a specified number of inter-layer edges are not restricted to adjacent layers as perturbed layered graphs. For perturbed layered graphs where O(1) inter-layer edges originating from each layer need not terminate in an adjacent layer an open question has been posed which seeks the complexity of computing MIS, MVC and MDS. We design FPT algorithms for computing these measure with dynamic programming. For several sub-classes of the above class we show that computation of MIS, MVC and MDS is tractable. Thereby, we partially answer the open question.

articleTitle: AgriSense: Automatic Irrigation Utility System Using Wireless Sensor Network and Web of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Traditional Agriculture method consumes a huge amount of fresh water for irrigation that needs to be optimized. This paper presents Web of Things (WoT) based an automatic WSN irrigation system that reduces fresh water consumption. The proposed irrigation system “AgriSense” contains three end nodes disseminated on the field, one router node, and one coordinator. Arduino Uno with Xbee and sensors (specifically temperature, humidity, and soil-moisture) opted for end nodes that send sensor data wirelessly to the coordinator using ZigBee protocol. Arduino Uno with relays works as router that operates water pump and valves. The Raspberry Pi board with Xbee acts as a coordinator node. Coordinator analyzes sensor data and commands the router to on/off the water pump and valves based on threshold values. Coordinator is also responsible for sensor data modeling with XML and XML/RDF data formats and sends these annotated sensor data to the web server. XML script is machine readable and widely used data format on the web and other platforms, thus it provides syntactical interoperability. The web server stores and parses this annotated sensor data and display it using graphical representation. This automatic irrigation system helps farmer to maximize yield with minimum human effort.

articleTitle: Machine learning using AMKSOM for Identifying Tumor around Edema region
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: In most of the part of India, the statistical data reveals that people die because of inaccurate and last stage predictions of disease. An automatic system identifying tumor and differentiating edema from tumor can effectively help neurosurgeon for follow-up and pre-surgical evaluation planning. Therefore, we have developed efficient algorithm which predict early biomarkers and exemplify brain disease. We have integrated adaptive moving mapping unsupervised mapping(AMSOM) with FK-means and feature extraction for improved data reduction with efficient clustering of tissues. We have carried out algorithm using real time data from hospital and reshaped to 256×256 pixel size for processing. The image analysis reveals discriminative brain patterns associated to the brain tumor detection improving mean square error 14%, psnr with 12% and accuracy with 6%. Here proposed method implemented gives better detection and evaluation yielding promising results for the MRI 1.5 Tesla T1 images with 22 features. Therefore, it will be used by radiologists in the study of brain aging and disease.

articleTitle: Developing a 3D Beam Former Model with Varied MIMO Channels
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) in conjunction with Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) is considered as an attractive solution for future generation wireless networks with frequency selective fading environments. In this paper, a MIMO-OFDM based 3D Beamformer (3DBF) model has been developed using MIMO antenna arrays with both uniform and non-uniform planar array structures. The spatial mobility of the users and varied MIMO antenna structures have been considered for bringing the effect of different channel conditions with WINNER-II spatial channel model which considers 3D beamforming aspects. For the performance evaluation and comparison, linear adaptive channel equalization algorithms namely the Least Mean Square (LMS) and the Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) have been considered to be adaptively compensated the channel impairments caused by frequency selectivity in the propagation environment and under the condition of varied MIMO channel. The various units of the 3DBF system are described and implemented under MATLAB simulation environment. Extensive simulated studies have been carried out for Bit Error Rate (BER) and 3D beamforming performance evaluation with MMSE equalizer, the varied filter tap for LMS and MIMO antenna structures. BER reduction of 66.67% is obtained for LMS equalizer over MMSE equalizer at a fixed SNR = 15 dB. The Mean Square Error (MSE) performance of the LMS equalizer at same SNR condition is improved than MMSE in proportion with the number of LMS filter tap and MIMO antenna structure which proves its superiority in the aspects of MIMO-OFDM based 3DBF system.

articleTitle: Secure, Privacy Enhanced and Anonymous Communication between Vehicle and Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: With the introduction of IoT and VANET based systems, more and more information is getting communicated among more and more entities. With this information outgrowth, Privacy and Anonymity are two important security goals which are getting more and more attention. This paper presents a mechanism to ensure privacy of data and anonymity of entities while communicating for payment of toll tax in a VANET based system.

articleTitle: EDPRL: A Language for Specifying Data Privacy Requirements of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Use of customer data, including personally identifiable information, by enterprises for business purposes raise privacy concerns. Rising incidents of privacy breaches show that there is an urgent need for designing and implementing proper privacy controls. The most important pre-requisite for this is the correct identification of data privacy requirements in a timely manner. Existence of large number of enterprise assets (that store and process customer data), and continuous changes in requirements, render such identification extremely difficult. Moreover, ad-hoc methods often lead to erroneous identification of requirements. It is important to devise a methodology for the structured representation of data privacy requirements that considers the intricate relationships between enterprise assets that handle those data. This would also enable the implementation of automated processes for privacy controls. This paper presents a structured language called Enterprise Data Privacy Requirement Language (EDPRL) for specifying privacy requirements of an enterprise.

articleTitle: Academic Enhancement System using EDM Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Educational Data Mining (EDM) is a current trending multidisciplinary research area that explores the data and develops the methods in educational environments. The challenges in the EDM includes predicting and improving the student's performance which helps both instructors and students, identifying the key factors that affect the performance of students, understanding the learning process of the students, providing the best suggestions to students for their future development. The accurate prediction of student's performance helps the instructors to take proactive measures, improve teaching methodologies and guide the students in a right way. This also helps the student's to be active and encourage them to put extra effort on their studies. In this work, to achieve the goals of EDM various statistical and data mining techniques are used. The raw datasets obtained through various resources are first explored and the goals are identified. Afterwards, the data mining techniques are used to identify the hidden relationships and extracting the knowledge from these datasets.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Scheduling for Distributed Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Energy efficient fault tolerant node scheduling is major design concern in highly dense distributed sensor networks (DSNs) for adequate sensing area coverage. In order to maintain sufficient coverage, the node scheduling must be optimal by making some of the sensor nodes into BACKOFF state while maintaining a fault tolerant minimal subset of OPERATIONAL nodes. This paper present the Fault-tolerant Adaptive Node Scheduling (FANS) mechanism, based on the relative battery voltage of the discharge curve. FANS uses battery discharge curve for computation of optimal wakeup rate of BACKOFF nodes by considering the node failure probabilities based on bathtub curve. The computation of fault-tolerant Adaptive Backoff Time (ABT) is derived from polynomial regression applied on the discharge curve and failure probabilities based on the Weibull distribution of the bathtub curve. The performance evaluation is tested through simulation to evaluate the performance of FANS. The simulation results show that FANS can maintain a higher number of OPERATIONAL nodes which higher coverage and lesser energy consumption as compared to OBSP and RBSP respectively.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Motor Drive's Improved Performance and Analysis with a New Modified Artificial Neural Network Based MPPT Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 Second International Conference on Advanced Computational and Communication Paradigms (ICACCP)
abstract: Sun energy is essential alternate energy supply for renewable energy source. For the most of part in India's sunshine hours are 6 hours, at the same time as India's sunshine hours are 3/4 months per year a day In order to track the energy from the sun, solar photovoltaic modules are required. The solar photovoltaic modules have multiple power outputs to meet load requirements. Though to maximizing the power from solar photovoltaic modules an artificial neural network (ANN) based maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller is used, such that to improve the efficiency of PV system even under abnormal weather conditions. And also to reduce the torque and current ripples of asynchronous motor drive. Here a DC-DC boost converter and a space vector modulation based inverter are used to provide the required power to the load. In addition, by comparing the traditional and proposed MPPT controllers with Matlab/Simulation results, to prove the better performance of proposed MPPT controller then the traditional MPPT methods under abnormal weather conditions. And actual verification and tabulation were also carried out.
